Onchain claims are easy to make. Proving them is the hard part here on X

Every day we see claims like 

Whales are accumulating ETH
Smart Money is buying SOL
Large holders are selling

But where is the evidence?

That’s why I built CHAINCHECK for the Nansen Meridian Buildathon

Every crypto tool tells you why you're right. I built ThesisArena to find out if you are.

State a thesis in plain English. It commits to the conditions that could prove you wrong before it weighs the evidence.
